protocol.unit: one real upstream NeuronRuntime, SparseJournal and FileAnchorWitnessStore
protocol.queue: one bounded FIFO with capacity equal to owner count; no worker concurrency
protocol.model: fixed executed signed-Q24 8x22 matrix projection; not a trained RR candidate
protocol.output: no external effect destination; DENY_ALL authority
protocol.primary_latency: wall time for entire owner tick including witness fsync
protocol.secondary_latency: full batch including FIFO construction; queue age separately
protocol.p99_scope: descriptive quantile of this run; 32 full-batch samples only
protocol.resource_state: cgroup before and after each fresh process; unexplained/OOM/limit events retain invalid flag
